## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits, for example `feat(postgres): read column privileges`
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Golden files updated if generated SQL changed
- [ ] Engine behaviour change links the page used from `docs/reference.md`
- [ ] Breaking change is marked with `!` and has a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
- [ ] STACK.md decision change includes an ADR
- [ ] No credentials, real hostnames or customer data in code, tests or docs
